intro.title: FUNDA — Permission Gate Directive
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Permission Gate Directive — a structural directive (*hasPermission) that hides or shows any piece of UI based on the current user's role and permission set. Applied as *hasPermission="'invoice:delete'" on a delete button, the directive checks the AuthService and either renders the template or clears it from the DOM entirely (not just hides it). You will support compound permissions with AND/OR logic via an options input, and implement an *hasRole variant.
intro.usecase: Role-based access control at the UI level is mandatory in HR platforms, financial systems, healthcare portals, and admin dashboards. The structural directive approach centralises RBAC logic and makes templates declarative and self-documenting.
